  • audio inputs; smartphones have improving but still limited sensor capabilities

  • cameras are preferred for documentaries, broadcast features, and high-end productions
  • • Adaptability: External accessories (lenses, microphones, gimbals) can narrow the gap between smartphone
  • and professional output for MoJo journalists

  • scheduling easier
